purpose: Design of stronger masking for LIRF's dark months: the masked LIRF context network with masking probability 0.5 (lm50_32) and 0.75 (lm75_32) instead of 0.25 (lm25_32, the member of v53/v54), read inside v54's dark-month arithmetic. A GO opens a separately declared development round (16 seeds, the twelve-month refit for the ranking); this design exports nothing.

disclosed.v54_lesson: docs/lirf_dark/README.md: v54's dark-month re-read transferred at alignment 0.64, January 2025's development reading, while thinned July had promised 1.89. January 2025 (LIRF naturally dark, leave-one-month-out on the other eleven months) therefore governs this design; thinned July is a no-harm check.
disclosed.masking_trend: docs/adsb_ctx3_lirf/README.md and docs/adsb_ctx3_lirf_mask/README.md: masking at 0.25 helped LIRF's unmatched rows most where LIRF is dark; no masking probability other than 0 and 0.25 has been fitted for LIRF.
disclosed.same_sets: Thinned July and January 2025 are the sets that selected w55 (v53) and w70_s750 (v54).

hardware: four AWS g6e.2xlarge (one L40S each), two lanes per GPU, tools/run_adsb_ctx_lomo.py --device cuda via tools/combo_queue.sh (ROUND=runs/lirf_mask2), infra/aws/gpu_authorization_20261001d.json (the user: 'yes, launch item 3 on GPU'). Thinned July re-predictions on the workstation CPU (tools/ctx3_lirf_predict.py --fold seasonal).

thinned_july.file: re-predicted on coverage-regime attempt a13 (July 2025 thinned to July 2026's coverage) on the workstation CPU

fits.footing: As configs/adsb_ctx3_lirf_mask_dev_v1.json for the same two folds: the control member's fits (lm25_32, seeds 801-816) were made on the same folds with the same code, settings except masking p, and the same hardware type.

sets: Exactly tools/run_lirf_dark.build_sets' dark sets: thinned_july (14,771 route rows below 20,000 s) and natural:2025-01 (11,254 LIRF non-population unmatched rows), with their v9 / shipped network / LIRF tree / label / day.
arithmetic: v54's dark-month value: network' = 0.30 ens_ctx_lirf + 0.70 M; blend 0.75 network' + 0.25 tree (v9 0), floor -12; gate u600 (tree - network' > 600 s: v9 0 / network' 0.2 / tree 0.8) (tools/run_lirf_dark.values with w 0.70, s 0.75).
control: M = the 8-seed mean of lm25_32 seeds 801-808 on the same fold (equal seed count).

candidates.lm50_32: M = the 8-seed mean of lm50_32 seeds 901-908
candidates.lm75_32: M = the 8-seed mean of lm75_32 seeds 901-908

seed_split_null: M = the 8-seed mean of lm25_32 seeds 809-816 against the control (the same variant, other seeds): the seed noise of an 8-seed comparison, computed with the same code.
metric: Primary: squared error of the set's rows with labels below 20,000 s, relative change against the control, paired-day 95% interval (10,000 day draws, seed 20261001), as in docs/lirf_dark/results_v1.json. Reported also: each variant against v54's own 16-seed lm25_32 member, and the variant's standalone route RMSE.
rule: GO for a variant when (1) January 2025's primary change is at most -B, where B = max(0.25%, 2 x |the seed-split null's January change|), and (2) thinned July's primary change is at most 0. Among GO variants the lowest January change. No GO: stronger masking closed for LIRF.
next_if_go: A separately declared development round for the GO variant: 8 more seeds (909-916) on both folds and 16 refit12 fits, read in v54's dark arithmetic against v54 (16 + 16 seeds), exported only at the user's word (v54's model part with July 2026's route rows recomputed, the reconciliation last).
never_read: No official score, ranking label or published aggregate. No ranking prediction is made by this design.
scorer: tools/lirf_mask2_report.py (written before any fit of this design finished)
